mechanism: fused tiled attention: the s x s scores never round-trip HBM (recomputed in backward)
source: Rabe & Staats (2021), Self-attention Does Not Need O(n^2) Memory, arXiv:2112.05682; Lefaudeux et al. (2022), xFormers

mechanism: kernel feature map phi(x)=elu(x)+1 replaces softmax: O(s) prefix state instead of s x s scores
source: Katharopoulos, Vyas, Pappas, Fleuret (2020), Transformers are RNNs, ICML 2020, PMLR 119:5156-5165

mechanism: fewer K/V heads (heads/4): smaller K/V projections, K/V repeated to all heads
source: Ainslie et al. (2023), GQA, EMNLP 2023; Shazeer (2019), Fast Transformer Decoding, arXiv:1911.02150

mechanism: low-rank factorization of embedding and unembedding through E = 128
source: Lan, Chen, Goodman, Gimpel, Sharma, Soricut (2020), ALBERT, ICLR 2020

mechanism: drops mean-centering and bias: fewer reductions and elementwise ops per norm
source: Zhang & Sennrich (2019), Root Mean Square Layer Normalization, NeurIPS 2019

mechanism: same RMSNorm function through F.rms_norm (fused CUDA kernel where available): isolates algorithm from implementation
source: Zhang & Sennrich (2019), NeurIPS 2019 (algorithm); Hsu et al. (2024), Liger Kernel: Efficient Triton Kernels for LLM Training, arXiv:2410.10989 (fused kernel benchmark)

mechanism: same rotary function compiled by torch.compile (Inductor) into fused kernels: one read and one write of Q and K instead of six eager operators
removes the positional encoding (NoPE): causal decoders still learn positional information from the attention mask
source: Haviv, Ram, Press, Izsak, Levy (2022), Findings of EMNLP 2022, pp. 1382-1390; Kazemnejad et al. (2023), NeurIPS 2023
